display.purpose: The single biggest number or headline on a screen (progress %, greeting).

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, UI chrome text.

caption.purpose: Secondary/meta text; bumps 1px on non-Latin scripts.

shadows.name: shadow-chip
shadows.purpose: Small glass controls — icon buttons, back pill.

shadows.name: shadow-accent
shadows.purpose: Filled interactive-magenta surfaces (pills, checked checkbox); becomes a 0 0 20px glow in dark mode.

shadows.name: shadow-hero
shadows.purpose: The one hero gradient panel per screen.

motion.name: ease-hl
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single gradient CTA allowed per screen — full-width, pill or rounded-lg depending on context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; min-height: 48px; width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 16px; background: linear-gradient(225deg, #e00f84 0%, #ff4f72 100%); color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(224,27,106,0.28); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.12); transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b80c6c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Surface
components.description: The base translucent, blurred card every list row, section, and panel in the app renders through.
components.css: .ds-glass-surface { border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.62); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(11,31,63,0.08); padding: 16px; }

components.name: Glass Icon Button
components.description: 44x44 circular icon control used in every header (back, search, profile, favorites).
components.html: <button class="ds-glass-icon-btn" aria-label="Search"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9"/><path d="M19.5 19.5L15.3 15.3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-glass-icon-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.95); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(11,31,63,0.08); color: #0b1f3f; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-glass-icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-glass-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b80c6c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: 36x36 circular purchased-toggle used on list rows.
components.css: .ds-checkbox { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-checkbox--checked { background: linear-gradient(225deg, #e00f84 0%, #ff4f72 100%); color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(224,15,132,0.3); } .ds-checkbox:not(.ds-checkbox--checked) { border: 2px solid #c9cfdc; background: transparent; color: transparent; }

components.name: Floating Tab Bar
components.description: Bottom navigation, inset from the screen edges rather than docked flush, with the active tab as a gradient pill.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; height: 68px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.95); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(11,31,63,0.14); padding: 0 8px; } .ds-tabbar-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; width: 48px; border-radius: 999px; color: #55617a; } .ds-tabbar-item--active { width: auto; padding: 0 16px; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(225deg, #e00f84 0%, #ff4f72 100%); color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(224,15,132,0.3); }

narrative.overview: Soft Glass is a frosted, light-filled surface language built for one specific condition: a phone held in one hand, in a supermarket aisle, by someone who may not read the screen's language well. Every surface is a translucent, blurred panel floating a few millimeters above a pale lavender-tinted canvas, never a flat opaque card, so the interface reads as light and layered rather than boxy. Color is rationed deliberately: a single magenta-to-orange gradient is the system's one loud gesture, reserved for exactly one call-to-action per screen, while everything a person must read or press lives on a separate, deliberately darkened interactive ramp that passes WCAG AA on its own. Dark mode is not a second design — it's the same glass system lit from the inside instead of from outside, following the OS setting only.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass surfaces (backdrop-filter: blur(20px)) over a pale, never-pure-white background
Exactly one gradient CTA per screen — a hard, enforced rule
A strict two-layer color split: vivid decorative hues vs. darkened AA-safe interactive hues, never mixed
Generous radii (22-28px) and large (44-48px) touch targets throughout
Script-aware typography: line-height and optical size shift per active script

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: The brand gradient ramp is decoration; the interactive ramp is for anything a user must read or press.

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: Exactly one .hl-gradient-cta element is allowed per screen.

rules.name: The Script-Bump Rule
rules.body: Any script other than Latin gets a 1px bump on caption and label sizes.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow carries a hue (navy for neutral, magenta for accent) — pure black/grey shadows don't appear.

dos: Do keep the brand gradient to one CTA element per screen.
Do use the interactive magenta and its hover/press darkenings for every readable, clickable, or focusable element.
Do pair every glass surface's backdrop-filter with an opaque fallback for unsupported browsers.
Do keep touch targets at 44-48px minimum everywhere.
Do let dark mode follow prefers-color-scheme only.
Do keep the three brand gradients identical between light and dark mode.
donts: Don't use any raw brand-ramp hue or its light tint as text color.
Don't use .hl-gradient-cta more than once per screen.
Don't replace the icon fallback chain with a plain broken-image state.
Don't add a manual light/dark toggle without a product decision.
Don't reach for a flat, opaque card style for a new screen without a reason.
